atoms.text: Bonnie is a Scottish tour guide. Will you explore Scotland with her?

instruction.text: Bonnie asks if you know where Scotland is. Select the UK map with Scotland highlighted.

feedback.correct: This is Scotland! Scotland is the second biggest country in the UK and is connected by land to England.

instruction.text: The tour will start and end in Scotland’s capital city. Answer Bonnie’s question.

atoms.a: “What is the name of Scotland’s capital city?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>What is the name of Scotland’s capital city?</voice>

instruction.text: Answer Bonnie’s question using the map by putting the words together.

atoms.a: “Edinburgh is on the coast. Do you know which body of water it is next to?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>Edinburgh is on the coast. Do you know which body of water it is next to?</voice>

instruction.text: Bonnie wants to know if you recognise the sights of Scotland. Select the three images of places in Scotland.

feedback.wrong: This is a tropical island in the Caribbean. Scotland is a lot colder, so you won’t find tropical islands there!

instruction.text: Bonnie wants to show you around both the cities and landscapes of Scotland. Drag the images to the correct group.

feedback.finish: Scotland has a population of over 5 million people. They are quite spread out because most of the country is made up of mountains and hills.
